description: NeuralGCM-style objective (user decisions 2026-10-20; Kochkov et al. 2024, arXiv 2311.07222, Methods 7.4): identical to exp7 (arm B: noise channel, M = 8 members, warm start from the finished deterministic symmetric 8-day network, curriculum 8, 16, 32 days) except that the energy score is taken on the lead-time-low-passed fields (all three balanced fields) and gains a MSE of each member's kinetic-energy spectrum against the truth's; no bias term. The spectrum weight is set once so the spectrum term equals the filtered energy-score term on the first training batch of 8-day windows, then frozen and recorded in the run manifest. The lead-time cutoff table (loss.lead_time_cutoff) is the measured subgrid-swap twin predictability schedule (user decisions 2026-10-20: coherence threshold 0.5, streamfunction-swap twins, coherence of the anomalies from the climatological coarse vorticity, cutoff contiguous from k = 1, mean of 8 twin pairs; source round21_neuralgcm/twin_subgrid/schedule_summary.json). The probe's bands (DCT-II over the 79 interior F points) are converted to the loss's 80-point wet-box DCT index by equal wavelength, k_loss = floor(k_probe * 80 / 79); a lead is rounded up to the next measured day (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32), so lead hours (24 (d - 1), 24 d] use that day's cutoff, and lead 0 is the full band.
